title: A tree witness refuses what a head witness refuses, from a logarithmic proof
note: Phase C. Each mutation removes one rule of the tree checkpoints in agent_substrate/witness.py: rollback, a fork at the cosigned size, an extension whose consistency is not proven, recording before answering, provisioning at the first record's leaf and only once, refusing a lost state, TRUNCATED and FORKED by root, the screening of junk (another witness, another log, a bad signature), the quorum's reach, STALE, the trust root's log, the scheme kept apart from the head protocol's, and the checkpoint's shape. tests/test_witness_tree.py holds each.

mutations.name: TW1_rollback
mutations.rationale: a smaller tree than the one cosigned is accepted: the history rolled back

mutations.name: TW2_fork_at_the_cosigned_size
mutations.rationale: another root at the cosigned size is cosigned: a fork

mutations.rationale: a proof offered where none is needed is ignored rather than refused

mutations.name: TW5_answers_before_recording
mutations.rationale: the witness cosigns a tree it has not recorded, and forgets it on a crash

mutations.name: TW7_provisioned_twice
mutations.rationale: provisioning again resets a witness's memory of what it cosigned

mutations.name: TW8_trusts_on_first_use
mutations.rationale: a witness that lost its state is not refused here, and fails on the read instead of saying why

mutations.name: TW9_truncation_unseen
mutations.rationale: a log cut below a cosigned tree is reported as something else

mutations.name: TW10_fork_unseen
mutations.rationale: a log whose tree differs from the cosigned one passes

mutations.name: TW11_signature_unchecked
mutations.rationale: a tree cosignature whose signature does not verify is counted

mutations.name: TW14_quorum_reach
mutations.rationale: a quorum's reach is taken from its furthest witness instead of its nearest
